summary: Tested KPI Lead Pulse dashboard end-to-end (iter59). Backend endpoint /api/reports/kpi-overview returns the new stages/months/prev_month shape correctly for current month, past month (2026-06 with Avg/Day, days_in_month=30, prev_month=May 2026 days=31), January (prev_month=null), and invalid month falls back to current. Seeded totals verified (MTD 4,067 · YTD 8,127). Frontend /kpi renders header with live clock (updates each second), Month dropdown defaulting to 2026-07, 4 KPI boxes, Pipeline Pulse stacked bars, Valid Leads card, all 4 stage tables with exact fixed dispositions (attempt=4, contacted=3, converted=5, closed=22), Conversion Metrics table, Conversion funnel with FTD/MTD/YTD toggles, 3 Chart.js canvases, and past-month behaviour (Avg/Day / Month headers + amber banner) that toggles back to FTD/MTD on returning to current month. en-IN number formatting visible (1,870 / 8,127).
critical_code_review_comments: KpiOverview.jsx is 420 lines — still within budget but approaching split threshold; consider extracting Charts and StageTable into subcomponents if it grows further.
Cache key in kpi_overview uses today string, so cache TTL of 120s is fine but callers with different filters share the same 'all' key — acceptable since only month/user_role vary.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing KPI_TEST seeded leads as per request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rewrote test_kpi_overview.py for the new stages/months/prev_month response shape (old iter57 version was still checking sections/conversion keys). All 6 tests pass. Frontend Playwright script validated all data-testids in review request.
